entries.zh: 倚傍人；信赖、依靠他人
entries.en: to trust in, rely on someone (confiar en él)

entries.zh: 倚怙；倚仗、信赖（怙字原稿存疑）
entries.en: to lean on, rely upon (variant of confiar en él)
entries.notes: 汉字栏带[疑:怙/恬]，字证依赖推断。

entries.zh: 满目；满眼皆是（西语词头残损，义或为「信赖/信任满目」存疑）
entries.en: to fill the eyes, be visible everywhere (moâ-ba̍k); headword damaged
entries.notes: 西语词头 confiar de[残]ura con 有缺损，汉/闽/官三栏但示「满目」，语义对不上词头，存疑。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕认可、赞同（词头 Conformar y aprobar，汉语栏空缺）
entries.en: to conform and approve (Chinese column empty)
entries.notes: 四栏中汉/闽/官皆[空]，仅有西语词头。

entries.zh: 没收；充公
entries.en: to confiscate

entries.zh: 没官；被官府没收充公
entries.en: to confiscate for the King; forfeit to the crown

entries.zh: 碏；糖碏、结晶糖（碏字原稿存疑，或作硝）
entries.en: rock sugar / crystallized sugar (confiter); character uncertain
entries.notes: 汉字带[疑:碏/硝]，但西语 Confiter 及闽南 côg 与「糖类」语义相合。

entries.zh: 碏砂；糖砂、砂糖结晶（confites 词头未完，碏字存疑）
entries.en: sugar grains / crystallized sugar (confites)
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:碏/硝]且西语词头括注残缺。

entries.zh: 糖花；蜜饯、糖渍果品（confites）
entries.en: sugared fruits, candied sweets, confections (confites)

entries.zh: 做茶料入；制糖点心的师傅、糖果匠（confitero；茶字原稿存疑或作菓）
entries.en: confectioner, maker of sweets and preserved fruits
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:茶/菓]，四字直译「做…料入」稍拗，但 Confitero 语义明确。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: illegible / damaged entry

entries.zh: 照；与别物相符、一致
entries.en: to conform with, match another thing

entries.zh: 通；与相似之物相合、相通
entries.en: to conform to the likeness, accord with what resembles it

entries.zh: 合意思；顺从他人之意、依人主见（合字原稿存疑）
entries.en: to comply with another's opinion, agree with another's view
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:合/台]，字证依赖推断。

entries.zh: 合同；符合文书、与契据相符（合同；合字存疑）
entries.en: to conform a document, agree with the writing; a contract/agreement (合tong)
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:合/台]；西语 vt escriptura 指「核验/符合文书」，双义并收。

entries.zh: 照旧；照先前惯例、一如旧例
entries.en: to conform to what went before; keep to the old way

entries.zh: 照前；照之前、依前例
entries.en: as before, in conformity with what came before

entries.zh: 凭字；依照所写文字、据文书
entries.en: according to what is written; conform to the text

entries.zh: 调和；调和其意愿、使之相合（和字原稿存疑）
entries.en: to reconcile, harmonize the will
entries.notes: 汉字[疑:和/扣]，字证依赖推断。

entries.zh: 调；相合的、一致的、谐调的
entries.en: conforming, consonant, in accord (tiâu)

entries.zh: 倚；依此、照此（音写污损）
entries.en: in conformity with that (conforme a eso)
entries.notes: 闽南音写 T99 污损难辨，仅官话栏 ỳ 与汉字「倚」互证。
